description: The Jungfraujoch is the high saddle between the Jungfrau and the Mönch. The railway station, the Sphinx observatory, and the other buildings stand in Fieschertal, in Valais, a few metres from the border with Lauterbrunnen in Bern. Snow and ice cover the col in every season, and the Jungfraufirn leads south from the saddle. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded, just below freezing, with a strong wind and no precipitation.
